job.title: Cloud Identity Engineer
job.description:
Cloud IAM Engineer
5 months contract
$1400 + super per day

Our Client is a government agency is seeking an experienced Cloud IAM Engineer to support the integration of SailPoint and Microsoft Entra ID with its Azure and AWS environments.

The project will move existing access arrangements to a standardised role-based model, replacing individually assigned permissions and supporting the onboarding of additional government agencies. You’ll work across identity integration, cloud access management and migration, helping establish a consistent approach to how access is provisioned and managed.

What you’ll do
  • Support the integration of SailPoint and Entra ID with Azure and AWS for identity provisioning and access management.
  • Migrating existing identities, groups and access assignments to a standardised role-based access model.
  • Implementing Azure RBAC and managed identity configurations, and supporting role-based access across AWS.
  • Working directly with agency stakeholders to coordinate onboarding, resolve access issues and manage migration exceptions.
  • Deploying standard identity and access configurations using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and DevOps tooling.
  • Representing the project in change advisory meetings and providing technical input on migration activities.
  • Decommissioning superseded identity components following successful migration.
What we'd love to see
  • 5+ years’ experience in IAM, identity engineering or cloud engineering with a strong identity focus.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID in enterprise environments.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with Azure and AWS and managing access to cloud resources.
  • Strong knowledge of role-based access control, Azure managed identities and identity federation.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Azure DevOps tooling.
  • The ability to explain complex technical issues, work directly with customers and take ownership of migration tasks.
Benefits
  • Flexible working: 3 days WFH per week, with your choice of Sydney CBD or Parramatta CBD office.
  • Long-term project and broader exposure: Work on a large-scale IAM program, gaining experience and building professional connections across multiple government agencies.
  • Extensions likely: Initial 5-month contract, with extensions anticipated given the long-term nature of the project.
  • Modern offices: Quality fit-outs and easy access to public transport at both Sydney CBD and Parramatta CBD locations.

Contact: Tito Tealdo from Enterprise IT Resources I titob@eitr.com.au

Based in Canberra or Melbourne

  • Lead the planning, development and execution of test cases across multiple testing phases
  • Establish, manage and oversee test environments and test infrastructure
  • Lead daily stand-ups and coordinate activities across testing teams and engineers
  • Manage defects, risks and issues, ensuring timely escalation where required
  • Analyse business and functional requirements to determine testing needs and coverage
  • Develop and maintain Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM) and Verification Traceability Matrices (VTM)
  • Coordinate and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities with business stakeholders
  • Work closely with vendors, service providers and internal teams to ensure testing objectives are achieved

About You

You are a highly capable Test Manager with a strong background delivering testing outcomes within large-scale infrastructure and telecommunications environments.

You bring a combination of strong technical expertise, stakeholder engagement skills and leadership capability, with the ability to manage complex testing streams from strategy through to execution.

Essential Experience

  • 7-10+ years' experience in Information Technology
  • 3-5+ years leading testing functions on large-scale infrastructure or telecommunications programs
  • Proven experience managing complex test environments and testing teams
  • Experience developing and executing enterprise-wide testing strategies
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, governance and quality assurance practices
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendors and cross-functional stakeholder groups
  • Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities
  • Strong analytical and reporting capability

Technical Expertise

  • Sound knowledge of infrastructure technologies, particularly networking environments

Desirable
